reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count` has been renamed to `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_total`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 exposes the metric under the new name doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_total instead of doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count, so queries, dashboards, and alerts that reference the old name no longer match it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts, and queries that reference doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count to use the new name doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_total.

proposed.statement: The Prometheus metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_count` has been renamed to `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_only_total` in Cilium 1.17.0, so it is exposed under the new name.
